Hi Olivia — thanks, the package looks solid.

Two quick asks if we proceed with a keynote-for-spotlight trade:
1) We need the Spotlight Roundtable to include an AV livestream feed to our hosted booth page (so remote partners can tune in).
2) Logo placement: we require prime placement in the mobile app (first-tier card) for at least 72 hours and a lanyard logo at 1/3 size of top-tier sponsors.
3) Speaker deliverables: 1 moderator (we’ll provide), 2 company speakers (45 mins total), plus an assigned ops contact and a pre-event run-through.

Budget-wise we were expecting the mid-tier spend (~$45k) if the trade covers livestream + extended app exposure. If you can confirm those three items, please send an updated SOW and the invoicing cadence (deposit + balance). I attached my speaker bio to expedite logistics.
